The operator's four questions

One workflow, four answers.

01

Where to go?

AI schedules the picking route around demand, distance and workload.

02

What to do?

The right info on a tablet, at the moment of the pick.

03

How did we do?

A camera reads what happened — setup, search, travel, picking.

04

How to improve?

Data feeds back; the schedule keeps learning.

The plot twist

The same camera reads the operator.

It turns motion into standard time — even per individual — plus a read on ergonomic load. (Our TIMEBLY 2 project, Vinnova.)

Cameras are sensitive

Skeletons, not faces.

Skeleton onlyFaces blurredSupport, not surveillance

Better, safer work — not watching people.

Back to where we started

The two gaps — narrower.

Gap 1 · Data

Low digitalisation → improved with AI vision. More of the work becomes visible, closer to real time.

Gap 2 · Scheduling

Built to buffer → improved with dynamic scheduling. On-demand picking that re-plans as things change.
